documents.title: Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30,2026.
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board M,Eeting Held On November 04,2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting For Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results during the earnings conference call, noting a standalone revenue of INR 247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR 269.23 crores. Management highlighted that export business growth and new OEM supply orders from the U.S. contributed positively to sales revenue and profitability. The company discussed capacity utilization around 75% to 78% and announced plans to add a new production line by the end of the financial year, alongside evaluations for a potential international plant location. Management also addressed input cost volatility, freight cost spikes, and long-term growth prospects ranging between 10% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Management expects sales growth and increased momentum to continue over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

guidance.claim: The company expects domestic growth between 8% to 10% and export growth between 15% to 20%.
guidance.quote: So, we have said in the last phone call also, our expectation from domestic growth is between 8%-10%. And our expectation from export growth is from 15%-20%.

guidance.claim: Management expects the value growth to be much more than volume growth.
guidance.quote: So, obviously, the value growth will be much more than the volume growth because our export prices are much more higher.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 15% growth rate in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Value is expected to grow by 15% on average for the next 2 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the footwear business experienced a degrowth in the last quarter due to drastic increases in sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So specifically, our footwear business, because you have to understand the price of raw material for footwear, not only the PVC prices, the sole prices increased drastically to -- it went up to almost like 2x, 3x last year -- sorry, in the last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Management anticipates very strong growth in the export market while not looking at very strong growth in the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: So anywhere between 10% to 15% growth, we are not looking very strong growth in the domestic market. But yes, we are looking at a very strong growth in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the FTA signed by India is a positive move that will increase customer sentiments to procure from India, especially in the Europe market.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects U.S. automotive business to increase significantly by 60% to 70% over the next three years.
demand_outlook.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right? In terms of US automotive.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the polyurethane business is currently muted and has not succeeded in increasing sales volume.
demand_outlook.quote: So, PU, still the business is muted right now. We have not been able to succeed too much in terms of the volume in PU and increasing in sales.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that increased export momentum is expected to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Growth in the export market will be higher than growth in the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: Our concentration towards our export business is much more and our growth in the export market will be higher than the growth in the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the European automotive industry is experiencing degrowth.
demand_outlook.quote: But if you see, European automotive industry is not growing as much rather than it's -- there is a story of degrowth over there.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the footwear business is not growing due to local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: The company ordered a new line for expansion in its current premises to start production towards the end of the financial year between February and March 2027, adding 5 lakh meters of capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: The capex plan for the financial year 2026-2027 is around INR 50 crores.
The company ordered a coating line and will install it in an existing facility instead of South India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have ordered a coating line. But instead of putting it in South India, we have found space in an existing facility only. So, we will put it here.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex on a global scale will be INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: If we do on a global scale, it will be INR300 crores over there.

capex_expansion.claim: The South plant will initially start with 500,000 millimeters per month.
capex_expansion.quote: And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that sustainable gross margin is expected to be 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Shipment costs increased significantly, being 4x higher during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that raw material prices went up sharply, followed by fluctuations and volatility.
margins_costs.quote: The prices went up very sharply, then there was a fall in prices of some raw materials. Then again, the prices went up again. So, it's been a very volatile situation.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices for paste PVC had gone up significantly, creating an initial availability challenge in March that has since resolved.
margins_costs.quote: So, obviously, it's a petroleum by-product. So, the prices have gone up and the prices have gone up significantly. So, there was a challenge initially in the month of March where people were expecting that there could be an issue regarding the availability of the raw material. But I think those issues are resolved now.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses decreased during the quarter due to lower freight costs and controlled maintenance and repair costs.
margins_costs.quote: Our freight cost has gone down in this quarter because of this war situation and all and second one our maintenance cost repair and maintenance cost and consumables were also controlled and because of these two reasons our other income reduced

margins_costs.claim: Imports account for nearly one-third of total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizers and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: The company received good OEM supply orders from the U.S. that contributed to export sales revenue and profitability.
orders_capacity.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization of existing capacity is between 75% to 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume sold in FY26 was 31 million meters.
The new coating line capacity is expected to increase monthly production by an average of 5 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Generally average is 5 lakh meter monthly. It is rough calculation, it could be 4 and 6 too, but average will be that.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management cited market volatility and external factors like Trump tariffs and the West Asia war affecting international plant location decisions.
risks_headwinds.quote: But because of all this Trump tariff, the West Asia war or multiple things happening in the last few years, we have not taken a final call where -- which should be the ideal location to put our plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Gulf War and West Asia war caused problems that impacted prices and increased shipping costs during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: The first one, because of the Gulf War the problem arises that impacted the price in Q1. And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that predicting raw material prices is very difficult due to uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, it's very difficult to predict the prices. Definitely, because things are settled right now. So, we don't see any increase in the near future as of today. It's very difficult to predict what Trump does tomorrow.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the world is moving towards deglobalization.
risks_headwinds.quote: But world is moving towards deglobalization also.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to start production from the newly ordered expansion line towards the end of the financial year between February and March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company's US automotive business will increase by 60% to 70% in the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

management_commitments.claim: Management projected a top line growth between 10% to 15% for the next 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have already said that you can expect a top line growth of between 10% to 12% for the next 3 years. This is what we can say currently right now.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the increased export momentum to continue in the next 2-3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2-3 years.

management_commitments.claim: The coating line ordered for the existing location should be completed by the end of the calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: We have already ordered for an existing location. So, by the end of this calendar year, it should be done.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects increased export momentum to continue in the next 2 to 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: It takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start once a decision is taken.
management_commitments.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
